# ANEXT Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base

## System Overview
ANEXT is an engineering studio delivering robust digital systems, scalable cloud infrastructure, and enterprise web applications.

## Services & Solutions
1. Distributed Architecture: Event-driven systems, microservices, gRPC, and REST APIs engineered for low latency and high availability.
2. Web Engineering: Fullstack static and dynamic web platforms utilizing Astro, Next.js, and modern React architectures with 100% Core Web Vitals compliance.
3. Cloud & Infrastructure: Containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD automation, server virtualization with Proxmox, and hybrid on-premise cloud deployments.
4. Database Architecture: Data modeling, relational and document stores (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), caching layers (Redis), and distributed object storage (MinIO).

## Engineering Process
1. Discovery & Strategy: Requirements mapping and domain-driven architectural planning.
2. Architecture Design: Fault-tolerant design, schema definition, and network topology.
3. Iterative Engineering: Clean code, strict TypeScript typing, modular component systems.
4. Production Deployment & Telemetry: Zero-downtime releases, monitoring, and scale optimization.
